newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam sells 16.6 bln dong T-notes, rate 11.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam sells 16.6 bln dong T-notes, rate 11.0 pct.

text.p: Vietnam sold 16.6 billion dong ($1.42 million) worth of one-year Treasury notes with an annual coupon of 11.0 percent to domestic institutions at an auction on Wednesday, an official at the State Bank of Vietnam said.
At the last sale of government paper, on July 16, the central bank sold 150 billion dong worth of one-year notes at a rate of 11.3 percent.
The issue date of the notes sold on Wednesday is July 25 and maturity will be on July 25, 1998.
The bank said allotments of stock, in dong, were as follows:
Vietnam General Insurance Corporation (Bao Viet) 15.0 billion
Petrolimex Joint Stock Insurance Company 0.6 billion
